scope: Curated candidate sources, not installed feed connectors or automated watches

sources.name: NASA Exoplanet Archive
sources.testable_question: Which observations and selection biases are in the source database?

sources.name: Berkeley SETI Breakthrough Listen Open Data
sources.testable_question: Can a candidate signal survive terrestrial interference controls and independent reanalysis?
sources.nonclaim: Archive availability is not a confirmed ETI signal

sources.name: IAA / SETI June 2026 detection declaration hosted by SETI Institute
sources.testable_question: Does a potential finding satisfy evidence, independent verification and announcement protocol?
sources.nonclaim: Protocol is not evidence of detected intelligence

sources.name: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy - Divine Hiddenness
sources.testable_question: Which premises change across competing arguments and what observations, if any, bear on them?
sources.nonclaim: A philosophical argument is not a sensor reading or physical G_d detection

sources.name: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy - Skeptical Theism
sources.testable_question: Are hiddenness and evil objections challenged without erasing their strongest form?
sources.nonclaim: Inability to falsify a metaphysical thesis is not confirming evidence
